taxonomySearchSet.name: First Peoples Arts Map news

taxonomySearchSet.name: Point of Interest
taxonomySearchSet.description: Point of Interest

taxonomySearchSet.name: Public Art
taxonomySearchSet.description: The “Public Art’ category includes any artworks that are installed in a place or manner that makes them accessible for viewing by the public. Includes publicly accessible sites of cultural significance.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Organization
taxonomySearchSet.description: The ‘Organization’ category includes Aboriginal or First Nations arts groups or organizations working in all disciplines.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Person
taxonomySearchSet.description: The ‘Person’ category includes Aboriginal or First Nations people who are working as artists or arts administrators.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Aboriginal Youth Engaged in the Arts
Event
taxonomySearchSet.description: The ‘Event’ category includes Aboriginal or First Nations arts and culture events, or those events that include a strong arts component that people should know about. This includes all artistic disciplines.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Resource
taxonomySearchSet.description: The ‘Resource’ category includes those entities that provide resources, services or other support relevant to Aboriginal artists, and that may not be exclusively First Nation or Aboriginal directed.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Administrator
taxonomySearchSet.description: Arts Administrators are those who create and support opportunities for artists, including curators, producers, arts and culture managers, etc.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Music
taxonomySearchSet.description: Music

taxonomySearchSet.name: Visual
taxonomySearchSet.description: Visual artists including Painter, Weaver, Carver, Jeweler, Graphic Designer, and other visual artists

taxonomySearchSet.name: Indigenous Arts Organization
taxonomySearchSet.description: An organization, group, or collective directed by Indigenous people with a mandate to create or present works in any discipline.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Art School
taxonomySearchSet.description: Art School

taxonomySearchSet.name: Producer (Performing)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Producer (Performing)

taxonomySearchSet.name: Archaeological Site
taxonomySearchSet.description: Archaeological Site

taxonomySearchSet.name: Archipelago
taxonomySearchSet.description: Group or chain of islands.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Arm
taxonomySearchSet.description: Long narrow extension of a water body.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bank / Banks
taxonomySearchSet.description: Abrupt slope at the edge of a waterbody.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bank / Banks (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: An elevation over which the depth of water is relatively shallow, but normally sufficient for safe surface navigation.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bank / Banks (3)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Elevated portion of the seafloor or lake bottom, exposed at low water or over which the depth of water is shallow.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bank / Banks (4)
taxonomySearchSet.description: An elevation over which the depth of water is relatively shallow, but normally sufficient for safe surface navigation. Plural of Bank (2)

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bar
taxonomySearchSet.description: A ridge or succession of ridges of sand or other unconsolidated material extending across the mouth of a river, harbour or bay and which may obstruct navigation.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bar (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: An offshore ridge or succession of ridges of sand or other unconsolidated material, either perpendicular to or parallel with the shore.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Basin (4)
taxonomySearchSet.description: A water feature similar to a cove or bay.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Basin (5)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Bowl-shaped head of a valley in foothills or mountains.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bay
taxonomySearchSet.description: Water area in an indentation of the shoreline of a sea, lake, or large river.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bays
taxonomySearchSet.description: Water area in an indentation of the shoreline of a sea, lake or large river. Plural of Bay.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Beach
taxonomySearchSet.description: Gently sloping shore of unconsolidated material along the margins of a sea, lake, or river.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Beaches
taxonomySearchSet.description: Gently sloping shore of unconsolidated material along the margins of a sea, lake or river. Plural of Beach.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bench
taxonomySearchSet.description: Level strip of land, bounded above and below by steeper slopes; a terrace.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bend
taxonomySearchSet.description: Change in the direction of a watercourse.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bight
taxonomySearchSet.description: Water area in a broad indentation of the shoreline.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bluff
taxonomySearchSet.description: A shoreline terrain elevation with an almost perpendicular face.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bluff (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: A steep-sided hill or promontory.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bluffs
taxonomySearchSet.description: A shoreline terrain elevation with an almost perpendicular face. Plural of Bluff (1)

taxonomySearchSet.name: Bog
taxonomySearchSet.description: Wet spongy land area, containing abundant organic matter.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Brook
taxonomySearchSet.description: Small watercourse, often a tributary to a river, stream, or creek.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Butte
taxonomySearchSet.description: Conspicuous isolated hill with steep sides and a flat top.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Camp
taxonomySearchSet.description: A place where tents or buildings serve as temporary residences

taxonomySearchSet.name: Canal
taxonomySearchSet.description: A natural or man-made freshwater channel used for navigation, irrigation, etc.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Canal (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: A narrow, saltwater passage between bodies of land.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Canyon (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Deep, narrow valley with precipitous walls.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Cape
taxonomySearchSet.description: Prominent elevated projection of land extending into a body of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Cascade
taxonomySearchSet.description: Waterfall with a small flow, normally descending over several levels.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Cave
taxonomySearchSet.description: Natural subterranean chamber open to the surface.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Caves
taxonomySearchSet.description: Natural subterranean chamber open to the surface. Plural of Cave.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Channel (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Alternative course in a flowing water body, or a distributary within a delta.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Channel (3)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Narrow stretch of water connecting two bodies of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: City
taxonomySearchSet.description: A populated place with legally defined boundaries, incorporated as a city municipality under the provincial Municipal Act.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Cliff
taxonomySearchSet.description: Steep rock face projecting nearly vertically from a body of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Cliff (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Steep rock face projecting nearly vertically from the surrounding land.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Cliffs
taxonomySearchSet.description: Steep rock face projecting nearly vertically from a body of water. Plural of Cliff (1).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Cliffs (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Steep rock face projecting nearly vertically from the surrounding land. Plural of Cliff (2).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Community
taxonomySearchSet.description: An unincorporated populated place, generally with a population of 50 or more, and having a recognized central area that might contain a post office, store and/or community hall, etc, intended for the use of the general public in the region.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Cone
taxonomySearchSet.description: Cone-shaped hill.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Cove (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Water area in a small indentation of the shoreline of a sea, lake or river.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Crag
taxonomySearchSet.description: Steep, jagged prominence on a mountain or cliff.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Crags
taxonomySearchSet.description: Steep, jagged prominence on a mountain or cliff. Plural of Crag.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Crater (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Bowl-shaped or funnel-shaped depression at the eruption site on a volcano.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Creek
taxonomySearchSet.description: Watercourse, usually smaller than a river.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Creek (3)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Narrow tidal inlet, usually with a watercourse flowing at its head (seldom used in BC.)

taxonomySearchSet.name: Depression
taxonomySearchSet.description: Low-lying land surrounded by higher land.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Dome
taxonomySearchSet.description: Mass of rock or ice with a rounded top, elevated above the surrounding terrain.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Domes
taxonomySearchSet.description: Mass of rock or ice with rounded top, elevated above the surrounding terrain. Plural of Dome.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Entrance
taxonomySearchSet.description: Outer end of a channel, harbour, or other water feature; usually allowing access to the waters within.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Falls
taxonomySearchSet.description: Perpendicular or steep descent of water. Variation of Waterfall.

taxonomySearchSet.name: First Nation Village
taxonomySearchSet.description: A village or community inhabited primarily by members of the same First Nation.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Fishing Site
taxonomySearchSet.description: A section in a watercourse or waterbody where there is good fishing, or was historically used for fishing

taxonomySearchSet.name: Flat (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Almost level land, usually found along a valley.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Flats
taxonomySearchSet.description: Level area of land usually composed of fine material, extending from the shore.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Flats (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Almost level land, usually found along a valley. Plural of Flat (2).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Flats (3)
taxonomySearchSet.description: A large area of flat, wet ground.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Forest
taxonomySearchSet.description: Expanse of tree-covered terrain

taxonomySearchSet.name: Fork
taxonomySearchSet.description: Branch of a stream.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Fork (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Junction of two streams; a confluence.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Former First Nation Village
taxonomySearchSet.description: A place formerly inhabited by First Nations' people, with no current population or that is usually uninhabited.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Gap (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Narrow opening through a ridge or mountain chain.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Glacier
taxonomySearchSet.description: Mass of permanent snow and ice flowing from an area of snow accumulation on higher ground.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Glaciers
taxonomySearchSet.description: Mass of permanent snow and ice flowing from an area of snow accumulation on higher ground. Plural of Glacier.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Gorge
taxonomySearchSet.description: Deep, narrow, steep-sided valley, usually containing a watercourse.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Group
taxonomySearchSet.description: More than one island in a centralized area.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Group (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: A number of peaks or mountains within a range of mountains.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Gulch
taxonomySearchSet.description: A small stream.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Gulch (4)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Deep, steeply graded, V-shaped declivity, sometimes containing a stream.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Harbour
taxonomySearchSet.description: Sheltered water in a shoreline indentation, suitable for mooring or anchoring vessels.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Head
taxonomySearchSet.description: High, prominent land feature extending into a sea or lake.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Highland
taxonomySearchSet.description: Area of elevated relief, not as high or rugged as a range of mountains or as level as a plateau.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Hill
taxonomySearchSet.description: Elevation of terrain rising prominently above the surrounding land.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Hills
taxonomySearchSet.description: Elevation of terrain rising prominently above the surrounding land. Plural of Hill.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Hotspring / Hot Spring
taxonomySearchSet.description: Site of a natural flow of hot or warm water issuing from the ground.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Hotsprings / Hot Springs
taxonomySearchSet.description: Site of a natural flow of hot or warm water issuing from the ground. Plural of Hotspring / Hot Spring.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Ice Cap / Icecap
taxonomySearchSet.description: Large dome-shaped mass of permanent ice and snow.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Icefield
taxonomySearchSet.description: Irregularly shaped mass of permanent snow and ice, generally forming the accumulation area of two or more glaciers.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Inlet (3)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Elongated body of water extending from a sea or lake.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Island
taxonomySearchSet.description: Land area surrounded by water or marsh.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Islands
taxonomySearchSet.description: Land area surrounded by water or marsh. Plural of Island.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Islet
taxonomySearchSet.description: Small island.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Islets
taxonomySearchSet.description: Small island. Plural of Islet.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Isthmus
taxonomySearchSet.description: Narrow neck of land, bordered on both sides by water, and connecting two larger land areas.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Knob
taxonomySearchSet.description: Rounded usually isolated part of a mountain; a hill.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Knoll (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Small rounded hill.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Lagoon
taxonomySearchSet.description: Body of water, separated from a lake, river, or sea by a narrow land barrier, which may completely enclose it or leave a shallow passageway into it.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Lake
taxonomySearchSet.description: Inland body of standing water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Lakes
taxonomySearchSet.description: Inland body of standing water. Plural of Lake.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Landing
taxonomySearchSet.description: A coastal or shore location where boats may put in to load or unload.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Ledge
taxonomySearchSet.description: Flat rock area, either projecting from a land mass into the water or rising from the sea floor.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Ledge (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Prominent shelf-like platform exposed on the face of a mountain or cliff.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Ledges
taxonomySearchSet.description: Flat rock area, either projecting from a land mass into the water or rising from the sea floor. Plural of Ledge (1).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Lookout
taxonomySearchSet.description: Elevation from which the surrounding terrain or seascape can be viewed.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Lowland
taxonomySearchSet.description: A general term for low-lying land or an extensive region of low land, especially near the coast and including the extended plains or country lying not far above tide level.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Marsh
taxonomySearchSet.description: Area of low-lying land, often flooded and usually characterized by growth of grass and reeds.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Meadow
taxonomySearchSet.description: Alpine or sub-alpine treeless area, characterized by seasonal grasses and wildflowers

taxonomySearchSet.name: Meadow (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Low-lying, flat, seasonally wet, grassy area.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Mount
taxonomySearchSet.description: Variation of Mountain: Mass of land prominently elevated above the surrounding terrain, bounded by steep slopes and rising to a summit and/or peaks. [думMount" preceding the name usually indicates that the feature is named after a person.]

taxonomySearchSet.name: Mountain
taxonomySearchSet.description: Mass of land prominently elevated above the surrounding terrain, bounded by steep slopes and rising to a summit and/or peaks.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Mountains
taxonomySearchSet.description: Mass of land prominently elevated above the surrounding terrain, bounded by steep slopes and rising to a summit and/or peaks. Plural of Mountain.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Mouth
taxonomySearchSet.description: The point where a river or stream flows into another body of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Narrows
taxonomySearchSet.description: Constricted section of a water body.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Notch
taxonomySearchSet.description: Deep but narrow opening through a ridge or mountain chain.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Ocean
taxonomySearchSet.description: Large body of salt water, global in scale.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Pass
taxonomySearchSet.description: Narrow stretch of water connecting two larger water bodies.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Pass (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Low opening in a mountain range or hills, offering a route from one side to the other.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Passage
taxonomySearchSet.description: Variation of Pass: Narrow stretch of water connecting two larger water bodies.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Peak (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Summit of a mountain or hill, or the mountain or hill itself.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Peaks
taxonomySearchSet.description: Summit of a mountain or hill, or the mountain or hill itself. Plural of Peak (2).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Peninsula
taxonomySearchSet.description: Elongated projection of land into a body of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Pinnacle
taxonomySearchSet.description: Small pointed peak, or a hill.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Plain (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Area of flat or gently rolling terrain.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Plains
taxonomySearchSet.description: Area of flat or gently rolling terrain. Plural of Plain (2).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Plateau
taxonomySearchSet.description: Extensive, elevated region, with either level terrain, or nearly uniform summit levels.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Point
taxonomySearchSet.description: Land area jutting into a water feature; also used for a convex change in direction of a shoreline.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Pond
taxonomySearchSet.description: Inland body of standing water, usually smaller than a lake.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Ponds
taxonomySearchSet.description: Inland body of standing water, usually smaller than a lake. Plural of Pond (1)

taxonomySearchSet.name: Portage
taxonomySearchSet.description: Trail around an obstacle in a watercourse or joining two bodies of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Prairie
taxonomySearchSet.description: Area of flat or gently rolling grassland; larger than a meadow and often extensive.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Range (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Group or chain of mountains or hills.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Ranges
taxonomySearchSet.description: Group or chain of mountains or hills. Plural of Range (2).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Rapids
taxonomySearchSet.description: Fast-flowing section of a watercourse, usually with turbulent water or exposed rocks.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Ravine
taxonomySearchSet.description: Deep, V-shaped declivity.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Reach
taxonomySearchSet.description: Relatively straight section of a river, lake, or inlet.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Reef
taxonomySearchSet.description: Rocks rising to or near the surface of a body of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Reefs
taxonomySearchSet.description: Rocks rising to or near the surface of a body of water. Plural of Reef.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Region
taxonomySearchSet.description: A relatively large area having specific characteristics which give it a certain unity.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Ridge (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Elongated stretch of elevated ground.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Riffle
taxonomySearchSet.description: Fast-flowing section of a watercourse, usually with turbulent water or exposed rocks.

taxonomySearchSet.name: River
taxonomySearchSet.description: Watercourse of variable size, which has tributaries and flows into a body of water or a larger watercourse.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Rock
taxonomySearchSet.description: Small mass of rock usually projecting above the water surface.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Rock (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Rocky hill, mountain or cliff; or a large boulder

taxonomySearchSet.name: Rocks
taxonomySearchSet.description: Small mass of rock usually projecting above the water surface. Plural of Rock (1).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Rocks (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Rocky hill, mountain or cliff; or large boulders. Plural of Rock (2).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Sea
taxonomySearchSet.description: A subdivision of salt water next in size to an ocean, partly or sometimes wholly enclosed by land.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Settlement
taxonomySearchSet.description: Any permanently occupied, unincorporated area normally identified by a single name, generally rural, and having a recognizable central focus.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Shoal
taxonomySearchSet.description: Elevation of the bed of a body of water; composed of unconsolidated material and posing a hazard to surface navigation.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Shoals
taxonomySearchSet.description: Elevation of the bed of a body of water; composed of unconsolidated material and posing a hazard to surface navigation. Plural of Shoal.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Shore
taxonomySearchSet.description: Narrow stretch of land bordering a body of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Slide
taxonomySearchSet.description: Scar and/or material from landslide or debris flow.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Slough
taxonomySearchSet.description: Backwater area, usually marshy; or a meander channel cut off from the main drainage.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Slough (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Shallow water-filled or marshy depression with no external drainage.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Snowfield
taxonomySearchSet.description: Irregularly shaped mass of permanent snow and ice, generally forming the accumulation area of two or more glaciers.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Sound
taxonomySearchSet.description: Large body of water from which two or more inlets, arms or channels branch off.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Sound (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Arm of the sea or a lake; inlet.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Spire
taxonomySearchSet.description: Tall, slender, sharp-pointed peak; or a mountain.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Spires
taxonomySearchSet.description: Tall, slender, sharp-pointed peak; or a mountain. Plural of Spire.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Spit
taxonomySearchSet.description: Long, low, narrow projection of unconsolidated material extending into a body of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Spring
taxonomySearchSet.description: Site of a natural flow of water issuing from the ground.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Springs
taxonomySearchSet.description: Site of a natural flow of water issuing from the ground. Plural of Spring.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Strait
taxonomySearchSet.description: Passage, usually navigable, connecting two larger bodies of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Straits
taxonomySearchSet.description: Passage, usually navigable, connecting two larger bodies of water. Plural of Strait.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Stream
taxonomySearchSet.description: Watercourse, smaller than a river.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Summit
taxonomySearchSet.description: Highest point of a mountain or hill.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Swamp
taxonomySearchSet.description: Low-lying land, permanently saturated with water and usually having trees and shrubs.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Tower
taxonomySearchSet.description: A conspicuous mountain or pinnacle.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Towers
taxonomySearchSet.description: A conspicuous mountain or pinnacle. Plural of Tower (1) (2760).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Town
taxonomySearchSet.description: A populated place with legally defined boundaries, incorporated as a town municipality under the provincial Municipal Act.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Trading Post
taxonomySearchSet.description: A locality with a trading post.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Trail
taxonomySearchSet.description: Footpath or track. [see also Historical Route]

taxonomySearchSet.name: Trench
taxonomySearchSet.description: Large-scale elongated depression between mountain ranges.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Trough
taxonomySearchSet.description: Long depression of the seafloor, characteristically flat-bottomed and steep-sided.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Tunnel
taxonomySearchSet.description: Underground passageway for a travel route (under a watercourse or arm of the sea, or through an elevation of terrain).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Unclassified
taxonomySearchSet.description: A named or formerly named feature, whose type is unknown or undetermined.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Valley
taxonomySearchSet.description: Long relatively narrow depression, commonly containing a river or other water feature.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Village
taxonomySearchSet.description: A populated place with legally defined boundaries, incorporated as a village municipality under the provincial Municipal Act.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Village (2)
taxonomySearchSet.description: An unincorporated populated place.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Volcano
taxonomySearchSet.description: Hills related to volcanic activity.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Volcanoes
taxonomySearchSet.description: Hills related to volcanic activity. Plural of Volcano (3901).

taxonomySearchSet.name: Waterfall
taxonomySearchSet.description: Perpendicular or steep descent of water.

taxonomySearchSet.name: Other
taxonomySearchSet.description: Other

taxonomySearchSet.name: Other Music
taxonomySearchSet.description: Other Music

taxonomySearchSet.name: Producer (Music)
taxonomySearchSet.description: Music producer
